faqs.a:
The city screening committee provided for in section 2.3.2 of the essential home repair
               program is hereby authorized to act in such a manner as is set forth in the essential
               home repair program, and the city manager is hereby authorized to sign all appropriate
               documents on behalf of the city screening committee.
(Code 1981, § 14-49; Ord. No. 1576, § 2, 7-2-1979; Ord. No. 2389, § 19, 1-5-1987)
